reference_sql:
WITH subs AS (  -- one row per subscription, with the plan of the user's subscription before
  SELECT user_id, subscription_id, start_date, plan_name,
         LAG(plan_name) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start_date) AS prev_plan
  FROM subscriptions
)
SELECT user_id, subscription_id, prev_plan, plan_name
FROM subs
WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND plan_name <> prev_plan

solver.query:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT user_id, subscription_id, start_date,
         LAG(plan_name) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start_date) AS prev_plan,
         plan_name
  FROM subscriptions
)
SELECT user_id, subscription_id, prev_plan, plan_name
FROM s
WHERE start_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND start_date <= DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND prev_plan IS NOT NULL AND prev_plan <> plan_name
